title: Geek Bar BRK Closed Pod Device
description:
Description
Warranty
Meet the Geek Bar BRK Closed Pod Device—a smarter, more sustainable way to enjoy your favourite Geek Bar flavours. From the makers of the bestselling Geek Bar Pulse and Pulse X disposables, this sleek, rechargeable device is designed exclusively for Geek Bar BRK Pods, delivering the same bold flavours and smooth satisfaction you love, in a new disposable pod system format!
The Geek Bar BRK System consists of a rechargeable battery device and disposable, prefilled BRK Pods, making it a convenient and eco-friendly alternative to traditional disposables. With 16mL, enjoy up to 20,000 puffs per pod, powered by dual mesh coils for consistently rich and flavourful vapour.
The Geek Bar BRK’s eye-catching 3D curved adaptive colour screen provides real-time battery and e-liquid level indicators, a puff timer, and two output modes—Regular Mode for a balanced experience and Pulse Mode for intensified performance—all easily adjustable with a single button press. Equipped with a long-lasting 1000mAh battery and easy USB Type-C charging, the BRK Device ensures uninterrupted enjoyment with minimal downtime.
With its compact disposable pod system design, dual output modes, intuitive interface, and premium flavours, the Geek Bar BRK Device offers a sustainable, everyday vaping experience!
1000 mAh Battery Capacity.
Two Modes: Normal Mode and Pulse Mode.
3D Curved Adaptive Colour Screen with Battery and E-liquid Indicators.
Puff Timer.
Rechargeable Via USB Type-C.
Please recycle when empty at a proper recycling depot.
Warranty
30 DAYS. NO HASSLES. GUARANTEED. YES, YOU READ THAT RIGHT.
We doubt you’ll have any problems with your purchases; however, we understand mistakes and oversights can happen. Sometimes it’s a manufacturing defect, poor battery life, or you just don’t like what you’ve paid for. No problem. For a period of 30 days from your purchase you can exchange your device for a new one or receive a FULL in-store or online credit. Physical damages to products void all warranties, express or implied.
DEVICE & DISPOSABLE WARRANTY CONDITIONS
To have a valid warranty claim on a device or disposable vape device, you must keep the product packaging/outer sleeve which contains the proof of purchase and authentication stickers. We cannot warranty devices or disposable vape devices without their original packaging.
